verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents its own self-hosted deployment option, but it is a hybrid model. Customers deploy and control the data-storage infrastructure, while Braintrust still provides the managed UI, authentication, and platform updates, so the full core product is not self-hosted. missing for 10: self-hosting of the UI/control plane and authentication, a fully air-gapped or standalone deployment, independent or hands-on corroboration of the self-hosted setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You deploy and control the infrastructure that stores your sensitive AI data, while Braintrust provides the managed UI, authentication, and platform updates.
keeping all customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, and prompts) within your own cloud account and region
